# Apatheia

Apatheia gives Obsidian a clean look its recorded description traces to Things. The colour scheme, the fonts, among them Ultra Lobster, the border radius and other visual details are adjusted through the Style Settings plugin.

![Apatheia screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amadeuswm/Obsidian-Apatheia/HEAD/promo_screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Apatheia"
    author: "amadeuswm"
    repo:   "amadeuswm/Obsidian-Apatheia"
    slug:   "apatheia"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/apatheia"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/amadeuswm/Obsidian-Apatheia"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amadeuswm/Obsidian-Apatheia/HEAD/promo_screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Customize workspace with a clean, Things-inspired aesthetic. Adjust color scheme, fonts (including Ultra Lobster), border radius and other visual details using Style Settings for a tailored Obsidian look."
}
```
